_hoursHelp: Leave "hours" empty [] to show 'Opening hours coming soon'. To publish hours, list one row per line you want shown, e.g. { "days": { "en": "Monday – Friday", "es": "Lunes a viernes" }, "time": { "en": "6 am – 8:30 pm", "es": "6 am – 8:30 pm" } }
_ordersHelp: Shopping cart and pickup orders. Customers add items from any section, choose a pickup day and time, and the site opens an email to 'sendTo' with the order written out (no server needed; they pay at pickup). minDaysAhead = earliest pickup day per section (0 = today, 1 = tomorrow); the strictest section in the cart wins. maxPerItem = most of one item per order. earliestPickup / latestPickup = pickup time window (24-hour clock); match them to the confirmed opening hours. Set enabled to false to hide all ordering.
